title: 병원 표지 읽기: 어디가 아파요? 몇 층으로 가요?
objective: By the end, you can pick the right department for a common health problem and use a hospital floor guide and door sign to find where to go and when.
summary: Learn to read hospital department signs and floor guides in Korea so you can find the right clinic.
note: The hospital name and the times on these signs are examples, not real information.

task.title: Read the signs and answer
task.line: Use the department list, the floor guide, and the door sign on page 1 to answer each question.

items.text: Go here for fever, colds, or stomach problems (for adults).
items.example: 열이 나고 머리가 아파요. 내과에 가요.

items.text: Doctors here see babies, children, and teens. Many people still say 소아과.
This is for your ears, nose, and throat.
Go here when you have a problem with your eyes.
Go here when you hurt your bones, joints, or back.
This is for women's health and pregnancy.
Sign in here first (접수), and pay here after you see the doctor (수납).
Go here at night or when a problem is serious and sudden.

sections.heading: 표지 보기 (Sample signs)
paragraphs: [층별 안내 · 한빛병원]  5F 피부과 · 산부인과 / 4F 정형외과 · 이비인후과 / 3F 안과 · 치과 / 2F 소아청소년과 / 1F 내과 · 접수·수납 · 응급실 / B1 주차장
[진료실 문 표지]  이비인후과 진료실 2 / 진료 시간: 월–금 09:00–18:00 / 점심시간: 13:00–14:00

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: On hospital signs, a word ending in 과 is a department: 안과, 치과, 내과. F means 층 (floor), so 3F = 3층. B1 means 지하 1층 (basement 1).
On a door sign, check 진료 시간 (clinic hours) and 점심시간 (lunch break). Doctors do not see patients during lunch.

exercises: Which department do you go to? Write it in Korean: ① 이가 아파요. ② 귀가 아파요. ③ 다섯 살 아이가 기침을 해요. ④ 점심을 먹고 배가 아파요.
Look at the floor guide. Which floor is it on? ① 피부과 ② 안과 ③ 소아청소년과
Choose the right department: 어제 넘어졌어요. 팔이 너무 아파요. (내과 / 정형외과)
Fill in the blank: 진료가 끝났어요. 이제 돈을 내요. ____ 창구로 가세요.
Look at the door sign. Can you see the doctor? Write Yes or No: ① 월요일 오후 1시 30분 ② 화요일 오전 10시
The clinics are closed now. Where do you go? Write it in Korean: 밤 11시예요. 다리를 많이 다쳤어요.
answers: ① 치과 ② 이비인후과 ③ 소아청소년과 (or 소아과) ④ 내과
① No (it is lunchtime, 13:00–14:00) ② Yes
